name: tnsaints-worker
description: Registration API for Tennessee Saints Basketball Academy evaluations

scripts.db:dump:local: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --local --command="SELECT * FROM registrations ORDER BY id"
scripts.staff:list: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --remote --command="SELECT email_norm, display_name, author_label, role, active FROM staff ORDER BY role, email_norm"
scripts.staff:list:local: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --local --command="SELECT email_norm, display_name, author_label, role, active FROM staff ORDER BY role, email_norm"
scripts.audit:tail: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --remote --command="SELECT at, actor, action, subject_type, subject_id FROM audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 40"
